text:
Corrected inventory for this epic, measured on the current tree (supersedes the count in my earlier note).

GENUINELY UNREACHABLE - 5, not 8:
  correlation(), cosine(), covariance()  -> effect_edge_normalizer
  fisher_z(), rank_edges()               -> effect_edge_transform
  Only consumer is .evaluate_edge_operation, still called from tests only. No exported function
  accepts either class.

LIVE, keep:
  aggregate_first(), reduce_partitions() -> effect_partition_reducer. User-settable on the
  exported measurement_form(reducer=), validated, and it changes the recorded stage_order.
  inner_product()                        -> pinned default at compiler.R:76,147,429 and
  evidence-task.R:336. Not variable, but referenced by live code.

So the epic decision narrows to one axis: does the normalizer/transform calculus get a public
workflow, or get deleted? The reducer axis is already wired and can stay.
